datasets.name: resumen_ahorro
queryLines:
SELECT
  SUM(estimated_monthly_savings_usd) AS ahorro_mensual_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confidence = 'alta' THEN estimated_monthly_savings_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ahorro_alta_confianza_usd,
  COUNT(*) AS recomendaciones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entity_key) AS recursos_afectados
FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_recommendation
WHERE analysis_date = (SELECT MAX(analysis_date) FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_recommendation)

datasets.name: ahorro_por_regla
datasets.displayName: Ahorro estimado por tipo de hallazgo
queryLines:
SELECT
  rule_id,
  COUNT(*) AS hallazgos,
  SUM(estimated_monthly_savings_usd) AS ahorro_mensual_usd
FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_recommendation
WHERE analysis_date = (SELECT MAX(analysis_date) FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_recommendation)
GROUP BY rule_id
ORDER BY ahorro_mensual_usd DESC

datasets.name: recomendaciones
queryLines:
SELECT
  rule_id,
  title,
  entity_name,
  entity_type,
  team,
  cost_center,
  environment,
  observed_cost_usd,
  estimated_monthly_savings_usd,
  confidence,
  severity,
  recommendation,
  estimation_method
FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_recommendation
WHERE analysis_date = (SELECT MAX(analysis_date) FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_recommendation)
ORDER BY estimated_monthly_savings_usd DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: eficiencia
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  ROUND(COALESCE(serverless_share, 0) * 100, 2) AS serverless_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(all_purpose_share, 0) * 100, 2) AS all_purpose_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(allocation_coverage_ratio, 0) * 100, 2) AS cobertura_pct,
  cost_per_dbu_usd
FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_kpi_daily
WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
ORDER BY usage_date

datasets.name: gasto_sin_atribuir
datasets.displayName: Gasto sin atribucion por recurso (30 dias)
queryLines:
SELECT
  entity_name,
  entity_type,
  workspace_id,
  SUM(total_cost_usd) AS costo_usd
FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_cost_daily
WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  AND is_untagged = true
GROUP BY entity_name, entity_type, workspace_id
ORDER BY costo_usd DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: jobs_inestables
datasets.displayName: Jobs con mayor desperdicio por fallos (30 dias)
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(job_name, CAST(job_id AS STRING)) AS job,
  team,
  COUNT(*) AS ejecuciones,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fallidas,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS tasa_fallo_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN run_cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS costo_fallido_usd
FROM finops_qa.gold.fct_job_run_cost
WHERE run_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY job, team
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY costo_fallido_usd DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: config_clusters
queryLines:
SELECT
  e.entity_name,
  e.workspace_id,
  e.autotermination_minutes,
  e.autoscale_enabled,
  e.num_workers,
  e.spark_version,
  e.days_since_activity,
  e.lifetime_cost_usd
FROM finops_qa.gold.dim_entity e
WHERE e.entity_type = 'CLUSTER'
ORDER BY e.lifetime_cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 100

datasets.name: salud_pipeline
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_date,
  stage,
  status,
  duration_seconds,
  rows_written,
  error_message
FROM finops_qa.gold.ops_run_log
WHERE run_started_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
ORDER BY run_started_at DESC, stage
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: alertas
queryLines:
SELECT
  created_at,
  rule_id,
  severity,
  title,
  scope,
  dispatch_status,
  channels,
  delivered
FROM finops_qa.gold.ops_alert_log
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200
